Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) targeting the DDX5 interactome using an antibody-based pull-down. Label-free quantification (LFQ) was used via MaxQuant.

scope: we determined and analyzed protein interaction networks of the endogenous DDX5 in different human PC cells using immunoaffinity purification mass spectrometry (IP-MS).

The protein extracts were pre cleaned with 40 µl of the protein A Sepharose... and was incubated with 5 µg of Ab against DDX5 (mouse monoclonal Ab, sc-365164, Santa Cruz Biotechnology) overnight at 4 °C. Subsequently, the immunoprecipitated complexes were captured by incubating with 40 µl of protein A Sepharose bead for 1 hr, 4 °C
